1. Relevant (erheblich) for the decision;
2. Still pending (anhängig) before another authority or court;
3. Not yet finally decided (nicht noch nicht rechtskräftig entschieden).

If these conditions are met, the court may order a stay of proceedings pursuant to 115 Abs. 2 FGO.

In summary, § 35 EStG provides for the deductibility of extraordinary burdens from taxable income, and the courts apply a three-part test to determine whether an expense qualifies as such.
